kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute update-compute-quota-plan --nickname os_ComputeQuota_p --name planA --quota '{"parameter":{"elasticReservedCU":50},"subQuotaInfoList":[{"nickName":"os_ComputeQuota","parameter":{"minCU":50,"elasticReservedCU":50,"maxCU":50}}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateComputeQuotaPlan

parameters.help_en: The nickname of level-1 compute quota
parameters.name: nickname

fields.help_en:
The value of elastic Reserved CUs in the level-1 quota.

> The default value is 0. The maximum value of this parameter must be equal to the number of subscription-based reserved CUs and cannot exceed 10,000 CUs
fields.help_zh:
一级Quota弹性预留CU值。
> 
> -    一级Quota ElasticReservedCU必须是50倍数
> -    一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 大于等于0
> -    一级Quota ElasticReservedCU 小于等于一级Quota MaxCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

element_fields.help_en: The nickname of the level-2 quota
element_fields.name: nick_name

fields.help_en:
The value of elastic Reserved CUs.

> The total number of elastically reserved CUs in all the level-2 quotas is equal to the number of elastically reserved CUs in the level-1 quota
fields.help_zh:
弹性预留CU值。
> 
> -    二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU大于等于0 
> -    二级Quota的ElasticReservedCU总和必须等于一级Quota ElasticReservedCU
fields.name: elastic_reserved_cu

fields.help_en:
The value of maxCU in Reserved CUs.

> The value of maxCU must be less than or equal to the value of maxCU in the level-1 quota that you purchased
fields.help_zh:
预留CU上限。
> 
> - 二级Quota的maxCU不能超过一级Quota的maxCU
fields.name: max_cu

fields.help_en:
The value of minCU in Reserved CUs.

> - The total value of minCU in all the level-2 quotas is equal to the value of minCU in the level-1 quota.
>
> - The value of minCU must be less than or equal to the value of maxCU in the level-2 quota and less than or equal to the value of minCU in the level-1 quota that you purchased
fields.help_zh:
预留CU保障。
> 
> - 所有二级Quota minCU总和需要等于 一级Quota的minCU
> - 二级Quota的minCU不能超过自身的maxCU
fields.name: min_cu

element_fields.help_en: The parameters of the level-2 quota
element_fields.name: parameter
